summary: Reproduced that candidate 4379f80 fixed only one of 53 audited sites. Preserved that fix and corrected the four representative review counterexamples plus Phi's independently resolver-tested sites. The broad audit still reports 38 syntactic hits, including several quant_config=None false positives, so this PR does not claim the repository-wide issue is fully solved.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate commit reproduced 52 missing-prefix sites; corrected tree reports 38, so broad coverage remains incomplete.
All four concrete independent-review counterexamples have explicit qualified prefix expressions.
18 tests and 42 subtests passed using real compressed-tensors, FP8, and ModelOpt quantization resolvers.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and focused regressions are CPU-only constructor/configuration-routing checks; no model weights or architecture execution were claimed.

remaining_limitations: The retained broad AST audit still reports 38 sites; some are false positives with literal quant_config=None, while the other architectures require separate qualified-name validation.
No affected full-model weights were available, so no semantic or serving-path validation was performed.
Whisper, Grok, Exaone, and Bailing v3 changes were source-level qualified-name checks, not full architecture executions.
